scenes.vo: Có người vừa trả gần năm triệu đô la cho một chú Mudkip do người chơi tự vẽ.
scenes.gloss: Someone just paid nearly five million dollars for a Mudkip a player drew himself.
scenes.viewer: A fortune was just paid for one small card.
scenes.build: reuse:cash desk; new: money sack with 14 bundles and 8 loose bills; the Mudkip slab on an acrylic stand at the right end of the desk.
scenes.blocking: Buyer, front view, behind the cash desk at the mark, both arms straight up holding the sack over his head from frame 0.
scenes.action: f0-24 wind-up held (sack at y 1.9). f25-29 he slams it down; contact f29, two frames before 'năm'. The sack squashes to 70 %, its neck pops; 14 bundles burst up and out on arcs (0.25-0.6 s), bounce once and stay on the desk and floor; 8 bills flutter down until f110. The slab on its stand hops 3 cm and settles. f58 the camera leaves him for the slab; a gleam crosses it on 'Mudkip' f71.
scenes.acting: Effort squint on the wind-up, wide grin after the slam, arms resting on the sack.

cams.why: low and wide on the wind-up and the slam
travel to what the money bought, during the debris

scenes.physics: sack: 4 f fall, squash 0.7 with a 6 f recover to 0.85. Bundles: ballistic arcs under 9.8 m/s2 from the sack mouth to rest spots on the desk (9) and the carpet (5), one bounce of 8 % height, spin stops at rest. Bills: 1.1 m/s terminal fall with a 0.12 m side sway.
scenes.light_mood: day, sun from screen right; cool room so the green bundles pop.
scenes.sound: whoosh f25, heavy thud + coin clink f29, paper flutter f31-90, Kaching meme f31, gleam chime f71.
scenes.after: Sack slumped on the desk, bundles and bills lying where they landed (S02 background is the other way; S13 uses the buyer again).

scenes.vo: Dân sưu tầm bật cười: "Mudkip á? Con cá bùn đó á? Charizard đâu?"
scenes.gloss: Collectors burst out laughing: 'Mudkip? That mud fish? Where's Charizard?'
scenes.viewer: The experts think it is a joke.
scenes.build: reuse:auction room seen toward the rostrum wall (soft). REAL Base Set Charizard in dB's hand.
scenes.blocking: Three collectors in a tight row, front view, low wide lens: dA left, dB middle half a step forward, dC right.
scenes.action: f130 all three crack up on 'bật cười' (shoulders bounce 3 cm at 4 Hz). f170 'Mudkip á?': dC points off screen right toward the cash desk. f202 'Con cá bùn': dA throws his head back. f232-240 dB lunges 0.6 m to the lens and thrusts the Charizard out at arm's length, card square to the lens on 'Charizard' f236; holo sheen sweeps it.
scenes.acting: Laugh, laugh, laugh; dB switches to a smug grin for his line, leaning into the lens.

cams.why: low wide chorus
he leans into the lens with the Charizard

scenes.sound: Emoji Laugh meme f134, small laughs f170-230, card whip f234, sparkle f238.
scenes.after: dB keeps the Charizard for S19.

scenes.vo: Nhưng chú Mudkip này không ra đời trong nhà máy.
scenes.gloss: But this Mudkip was not born in a factory.
scenes.viewer: Normal cards are stamped out by the thousand. Not this one.

out.note: time jump: over ten years back

scenes.build: new: conveyor, press, blanks in, REAL printed cards out.
scenes.blocking: No people. The lens hangs over the belt and looks down the line: the belt is a ribbon up the frame, the press mid-frame.
scenes.action: Every 15 f the belt indexes 0.75 m (9 f) and dwells (6 f); the press head drops in 2 f onto the blank under it and lifts in 4 f; the blank leaves as a printed card. Stamps at f277, 292, 307, 322 ('không'), 337, 352 ('máy'). Printed cards ride toward the lens and pass under it.

cams.why: down the line, press mid-frame
closer on the printed cards coming at us

scenes.physics: belt index with smooth start and stop; the press head falls in 2 f and lifts in 4 f.
scenes.sound: motor hum, pneumatic hiss + stamp thud on each stamp frame, belt clack on each index.

scenes.vo: Hơn mười năm trước, một người tên Daisuke Ochiai vẽ nó ...
scenes.gloss: Over ten years ago, a man named Daisuke Ochiai drew it ...
scenes.viewer: One person drew it, at his desk.
scenes.build: adapt:study as his room; new: console open on the desk, stylus.
scenes.blocking: Daisuke sits behind the desk, front view, head tilted down to the console; his right arm (3D stick arm) holds the stylus on the lower screen.
scenes.action: His stylus hand moves in short strokes (2-3 cm, 5 per second) over the lower screen; he pauses at f421, looks up and thinks, then back down on 'Daisuke' f433 as the title glides in.
scenes.acting: Tongue-out concentration (lick), a thinking look up, a small smile.

cams.why: him at the desk, the console between us

scenes.light_mood: day, soft window light from the left.
scenes.sound: room tone, stylus taps, soft music-box theme.

scenes.vo: ... vẽ nó để dự thi trong một trò chơi tập vẽ Pokémon. Bức tranh thắng giải. Phần thưởng là tranh của anh được in ...
scenes.gloss: ... to enter a contest in a Pokémon drawing game. The drawing won. The prize: his drawing printed ...
scenes.viewer: The picture on the card is his own drawing, and it won.

out.note: push into the drawing on the lower screen; it becomes the art window of the real card

scenes.build: console screens are live canvases: the lower one shows the REAL card art (the art window cropped from the scan) appearing under the stylus; the upper one shows a plain contest page, then a gold WINNER rosette.
scenes.blocking: Top-down over the console; the stylus and his forearm come in from the bottom right.
scenes.action: f466-551 the stylus scrubs across the lower screen and the drawing appears where it has been (pencil lines first, colour 20 f behind). f551 last stroke, stylus lifts. f586 'thắng': the upper screen flashes and a gold rosette stamps on; a ring of confetti bursts over the console. f634-659 push into the drawing.

cams.why: both screens, the drawing appearing
through-object: the drawing fills the frame

scenes.physics: confetti: 24 paper bits on short arcs.
scenes.sound: pencil scratch loop f466-551, Realization Sound f586, chime.
scenes.after: The finished drawing stays on the lower screen.

scenes.vo: ... thành thẻ bài, đúng một trăm lá, và cả một trăm lá về tay anh.
scenes.gloss: ... as a card: exactly one hundred copies, and all one hundred went to him.
scenes.viewer: Only 100 exist and he got them all.
scenes.build: new: open parcel on the desk with the 100-card block inside, REAL Mudkip scan on top. The console is pushed to the desk's left end; the parcel sits at his edge of the desk, inside his reach.
scenes.blocking: Starts top-down on the card's art window (same picture, same place in frame as the screen; the lens is now on our side of the desk, so the card lies with its top toward him and reads upright for us). Daisuke sits behind the desk.
scenes.action: f667-695 the camera lifts back and tilts up: the whole card, the block's ruled edge, the open parcel around it (he is still above the frame). f715 the camera comes down to him. f680 title '100' on 'đúng một trăm lá'. f725-737 both arms reach in and grip the block's sides; f737-751 he lifts it out of the parcel and tips its face to us; f752-769 he hugs it to his chest on 'về tay anh'.
scenes.acting: Open-mouthed awe, then a closed-eye grin hugging the block.

cams.why: match: the drawing is now the card's art
pull back to the block of 100 in its parcel
settle on him as he lifts it out

marks.pose: sit; lift and hug the block f731-769

scenes.sound: paper rustle f667, soft whoosh, glock hit on '100' f692, cardboard scrape f735.
scenes.after: He keeps the block; the empty parcel stays.

scenes.vo: Không cửa hàng nào bán. Không gói thẻ nào có.
scenes.gloss: No shop sells it. No pack has it.
scenes.build: new: card shop (shelves of sealed boxes, glass counter with three REAL cards on stands), foil pack, torn-wrapper pile.
scenes.blocking: Keeper behind the counter right of centre, front view. Kid in front of the counter on the left, front view, a pack in both hands.
scenes.action: f786-815 the keeper shakes his head three times (head tilt +-7 deg) with both palms out. f820 glide to the kid: f829-831 he rips the top strip off on 'gói' (the strip flies up-left and falls); five real cards fan up out of the pack and drop around his feet by f850; he stares into the empty wrapper on 'có'.
scenes.acting: Keeper: stern, eyes closed on the shake. Kid: hopeful grin, then dazed.

cams.why: shop, keeper and kid
the pack

scenes.physics: strip and cards on ballistic arcs with spin; cards land flat and stay.
scenes.sound: door bell f781, foil rip f829, card flutter, Buzzer meme (short) f846.

scenes.vo: Gần hai năm trước, một lá đạt điểm mười tuyệt đối bán được bốn mươi hai nghìn đô.
scenes.gloss: Nearly two years ago, one graded a perfect ten sold for forty-two thousand dollars.
scenes.build: the locked board frame: date plate, price board, auctioneer on the stage behind the rostrum, the Mudkip slab on column A.
scenes.blocking: Auctioneer front view at his mark, gavel in hand at rest.
scenes.action: f881-890 the date plate flaps to 'THÁNG 11 · 2024'. f905 glide to the slab: a gleam runs over the label's GEM MT 10 on 'điểm mười' f925-931. f948 back to the locked frame. f953-988 the board rolls $0 -> $42,000. f984 gavel up, f990 strike on 'đô'; SOLD lamp on.
scenes.acting: Auctioneer: stern, a nod and a small smile after the strike.

cams.why: the locked frame: date, board, gavel, lot
the grade: GEM MT 10
back for the price and the gavel

scenes.physics: gavel: 4 f up, held 2 f, 1 f down, 3 f rebound.
scenes.sound: flap clatter f881, shimmer f925, digit ticks f953-988, gavel crack f990, polite applause.

scenes.gloss: Expensive, but you can still understand it.
scenes.blocking: The three collectors, same marks as S02.
scenes.action: f1005 dA raises both arms in a shrug on 'Đắt'. f1021-1045 dB nods twice. f1045 dC tilts his head and gives a closed smile on 'hiểu được'.

cams.why: the chorus again, same framing as S02

scenes.vo: Tháng chín năm nay, một lá khác lên ba triệu bảy trăm hai mươi nghìn.
scenes.gloss: This September, another one went to three million seven hundred and twenty thousand.
scenes.viewer: Same card, same frame: now $3.72 million. The board was not built for it.
scenes.build: the locked board frame; the board grows two wings.
scenes.action: f1072-1081 the date plate flaps to 'THÁNG 9 · 2026'. f1111 the board starts rolling up from $42,000. f1127 'ba triệu': it runs out of room, both wings slam out (clunk, kick) and the digits spread to seven figures. f1175 it stops on $3,720,000. f1173 gavel up, f1179 strike on 'nghìn'. The slab hops 2 cm.
scenes.acting: Auctioneer: stern, then eyes wide (shock) when the wings fly out, grin on the strike.

cams.why: locked: same frame, bigger number

scenes.physics: wings: 5 f out with a 2-frame overshoot of 2 cm; slab hop 2 cm, 6 f.
scenes.sound: flap clatter f1072, fast digit ticks rising in pitch, metal clunk f1127, gavel f1179, gasp + applause.

scenes.vo: Ba ngày sau, một chú Pikachu mặc áo mưa, cũng từ một cuộc thi vẽ như thế, bán tám triệu bốn trăm nghìn.
scenes.gloss: Three days later, a Pikachu in a raincoat, from the same kind of drawing contest, sold for eight million four hundred thousand.
scenes.build: the locked board frame; column A now carries the REAL raincoat Pikachu in its slab.
scenes.action: f1195-1203 the date plate flaps to '3 NGÀY SAU'. f1213 glide to the slab: the raincoat Pikachu, gleam on 'áo mưa' f1250. f1300 back to the locked frame. f1313-1352 the board rolls $0 -> $8,400,000. f1351 gavel up, f1357 strike on 'nghìn'; slab hops.

cams.why: locked: three days later
the raincoat Pikachu
back for $8.4M and the gavel

scenes.sound: flap f1195, rain-stick shimmer f1228, digit ticks, gavel f1357, Wowww meme (short) f1358.

scenes.vo: Một tháng sau, thêm một lá Mudkip lên sàn.
scenes.gloss: A month later, one more Mudkip goes on the block.
scenes.viewer: The Mudkip from the opening comes up for sale.
scenes.build: the stage in warm evening light; column A empty; attendant with the Mudkip slab on a red velvet cushion (26 x 6 x 20 cm).
scenes.blocking: Attendant walks in along the back of the stage from screen right (side view), stops behind and to the right of column A, turns front.
scenes.action: f1376-1384 the date plate flaps to '1 THÁNG SAU'; the board resets to $0 (its wings stay out). f1380-1414 he walks in (0.7 m, 2 steps), cushion at chest height. f1420-1433 his left arm lifts the slab off the cushion and stands it on the column; contact f1433, two frames before 'sàn'; a gleam crosses it.

cams.why: the stage a touch wider, room for him to walk in

scenes.light_mood: golden: this sale gets its own light.
scenes.sound: flap f1376, footsteps on wood, soft clack f1433, riser starts.
scenes.after: Mudkip slab on column A for S14 and S18.

scenes.vo: Bảy mươi ba lần ra giá.
scenes.build: the room from the rostrum; numbered paddles (white discs 22 cm on a stick).
scenes.blocking: Six bidders front view in two loose rows; the buyer from S01 front centre.
scenes.action: Paddles shoot up one after another, each up 5 f, held 6 f, down 5 f, in a wave that speeds up (11 raises in 44 f). The buyer raises his last, f1481 on 'ra giá', and keeps it up. Title '73'.

cams.why: the whole room bidding, from the rostrum

scenes.sound: paddle whooshes, murmur rising, riser to f1496.

scenes.vo: Chốt ở bốn triệu tám trăm tám mươi nghìn đô.
scenes.gloss: Hammered at four million eight hundred and eighty thousand dollars.
scenes.build: the locked board frame in golden light, board already wide.
scenes.action: f1496 'Chốt': the gavel goes up over his shoulder in 4 f and is HELD. f1500-1559 the board rolls $1,000,000 -> $4,880,000, slowing into the last digits. f1557-1562 stillness: everything stops. f1563 strike, two frames before 'đô': crack, kick, spark burst at the block, the SOLD lamp snaps on, the slab jumps 4 cm and rattles to rest, dust falls from the board.
scenes.acting: Auctioneer: stern through the hold, a huge grin on the strike.

cams.why: locked: the climax in the frame we know

scenes.physics: slab: launched at 0.9 m/s, falls back under gravity, two rattles of 1 cm and 0.4 cm, rests by f1578.
scenes.light_mood: golden; the SOLD lamp blooms red.
scenes.sound: riser cut to silence f1557, gavel crack f1563 with a low boom, Kaching meme f1565, crowd roar.
scenes.after: Board holds $4,880,000; slab stays for S18.

scenes.vo: Khoan, một con cá bùn đắt hơn cả căn biệt thự?
scenes.gloss: Wait, a mud fish costs more than a whole villa?
scenes.viewer: The little card outweighs a villa. Literally.
scenes.build: new: a giant brass balance on a lawn. The villa sits on the far pan, resting on the grass; the near pan hangs empty at chest height.
scenes.blocking: dA stands right of the near pan, front view, the slab in his left hand (screen left, the pan side).
scenes.action: f1580 'Khoan': wide, he stares at the slab in his hand; the villa sits on the far pan in the distance. f1597 the camera steps in. f1604-1622 he lifts the slab over the pan and stands it down; contact f1624. f1626-1638 the near pan drops 1.3 m, accelerating, as the camera pulls back; f1638 it hits the grass on 'đắt hơn': thud, kick, dust ring, the slab hops 6 cm. The far pan is thrown up 3.9 m: the villa leaves it by 0.4 m and lands back at f1654, pool water slopping over the side. It hangs there on 'căn biệt thự'.
scenes.acting: dA: dazed at the slab, then shock; his jaw drops to the grass at f1654.

cams.why: the whole balance: him and the pan near, the villa far
step in: the slab goes on the pan
pull back with the drop: the villa goes up

marks.pose: stands the slab on the pan

scenes.physics: beam: constant angular acceleration over 12 f, hard stop on the grass; villa: thrown at the far end's speed, free flight 0.4 m above the pan, lands with one 5 cm bounce; pans hang plumb on their chains.
scenes.light_mood: bright day, blue sky: the joke gets daylight.
scenes.sound: Huh meme f1582, brass creak f1626, heavy thud f1638, water splash f1644, Instagram Thud for the jaw f1654.

scenes.vo: Hóa ra, người ta không trả tiền cho con Pokémon. Mà trả cho một con số.
scenes.gloss: It turns out people are not paying for the Pokémon. They are paying for a number.
scenes.viewer: Cover the picture: the value is in the number on the label.
scenes.build: the calm set: a warm wooden table with a green cutting mat, top-down. The slab lying flat; a kraft card; a brass loupe.
scenes.blocking: Hands only: a stick arm comes in from the bottom right.
scenes.action: f1675-1682 the slab drops flat onto the mat (lands f1682, small bounce) on 'Hóa ra'. f1708-1722 the arm slides the kraft card over the picture: Mudkip is gone on 'không trả tiền'; only the label is left. f1779-1798 the arm brings the loupe over the grade box; the glass shows the 10 twice the size on 'con số' f1802.

cams.why: top-down, calm
push in on the label and the loupe

scenes.physics: slab: 0.25 m drop, one 1 cm bounce.
scenes.sound: music drops to a soft pad; plastic clack f1682, paper slide f1710, brass tick f1798, Realization Sound f1802.

scenes.vo: Một trăm lá được in ra. Đến hôm nay, chỉ ba lá được chấm điểm mười. Cả thế giới có ba.
scenes.gloss: One hundred were printed. To this day only three have been graded a ten. The whole world has three.
scenes.build: same table, wider. 100 REAL Mudkip cards; three slab cases.
scenes.action: f1823-1856 the 100 cards are dealt in from the bottom edge, three per frame, each sliding to its place in a 10 x 10 spread (rows shingled); title '100'. f1903, 1910, 1917 three slab cases drop onto three of the cards (clack, clack, clack) on 'ba lá'; their 10s flash on 'mười' f1937. f1950 a gust crosses the table from the bottom of the frame (someone blows): the 97 loose cards lift and skid away up and off the table, bottom rows first, gone by f1972; the three heavy slabs stay put. f1962 the camera pushes in on them; title '3/100' on 'có ba'.

cams.why: top-down on the whole spread
push in: three left

scenes.physics: cards: 8 f slide with ease-out and a 3 deg settle; cases: 0.5 m drop each (10 f), 4 mm bounce; gust: each loose card accelerates at 6 m/s2 from the moment the gust front reaches it (bottom rows first, 8 f bottom to top), lifting 3 cm and spinning; the slabs (30x the weight) do not move.
scenes.sound: card riffle f1823-1856, glock on '100', three clacks, shimmer f1937, a blown whoosh and paper flutter f1950-1972, low hit on '3/100' f1977.

scenes.vo: Cùng phiên đấu giá đó, lá Pikachu cúp vàng huyền thoại từ năm chín mươi bảy cũng lên sàn. Ba triệu đô. Về nhì.
scenes.gloss: At that same auction, the legendary gold trophy Pikachu from 1997 also went on the block. Three million dollars. Second place.
scenes.viewer: The most famous trophy card sold the same night and came second.
scenes.build: the locked board frame, golden. Column B; the REAL 1997 No.1 Trainer in a slab on the red cushion; light-up numerals on both columns.
scenes.blocking: Auctioneer at his mark. Attendant stands at stage right behind the line of the columns, at the edge of the locked frame, the cushion at his chest; his arm reaches forward to column B.
scenes.action: f1996-2020 column B grinds up out of the stage beside the Mudkip (0.5 -> 1.78 m); the board resets to $0. f2022 glide to the cushion in the attendant's hands: the trophy Pikachu, gold gleam on 'cúp vàng' f2056-2067; title '1997'. f2105 back to the locked frame; f2109-2122 his arm stands the slab on column B on 'lên sàn'. f2137-2157 the board rolls to $3,080,500; f2153 gavel up, f2159 strike on 'đô'. f2163 the camera drops to the two columns. f2167-2181 'Về nhì': column B sinks to 1.45 m and column A rises to 1.95 m with a stone grind; f2181 the numerals light: 1 under the Mudkip, 2 under the trophy Pikachu.

cams.why: locked: the same night
the trophy Pikachu on its cushion
back: it goes on the block, the price, the gavel
